actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Wallet is zero, cannot punish or contribute. No one contributed >30 in last round, so I rest and broadcast the standard discouragement.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 0.0, cannot punish (cost severity *0.3 must be <= wallet). So can only rest. Also broadcast is allowed even with 0 wallet. Rule: if any other resident contributed >30 units in most recent round (round 10). Look at round 10 contributions: max is Resident4 1.095, Resident2 0.52, Resident5 1.0. None >30. So no punish. Wallet below threshold, cannot contribute 1. So rest. Broadcast discouraging message.
